description: Traffic volumes on top 40 road sections in SA is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. A ranking of the top 40 road sections based on the average daily two way traffic count. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are motor vehicle, road, traffic. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX. The portal shows 2026-02-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
